description: The user's spaces (communities) where a campaign can run MEMBERS-ONLY: spaces they own, may create campaigns in, or run as a delegate, with each space's member count. Free. Call it BEFORE creating any campaign (boost_post, create_campaign, create_content_campaign, create_action_campaign, create_watch_quiz, create_ai_visibility_check, launch_tiktok_campaign): if it lists a space, ask the user "public network, or only <space name>'s members?" — a campaign cannot move between the two after it is created. A space with member_count 0 cannot run a campaign yet. Then pass the chosen id as space_id (on create_campaign: space_id + members_only: true).
name: list_spaces
title: List the spaces a campaign can run in
